summary: Add exact artifact-intent capability routing and the shared lazy-loaded PDF Styler reference capability without creating a plugins root.

candidates.rationale: Add a small deterministic registry/resolver that selects skill context from operation + artifact type without loading skill contents.
Promote the existing Design Workspace PDF Styler into a self-contained shared ICM skill with local manifest/style resolution and executable regression coverage.
Integrate lazy capability routing into the root router, CLI, workspace metadata, impact classification, documentation, and locality tests while retaining existing authority boundaries.
Correct skill token accounting so skills-root metadata is not mislabeled as a skill and add PDF Styler context-economics coverage.
Document the v0.8 lazy shared-capability behavior and PDF routing semantics.

applied_changes.description: Added exact artifact-intent capability registry/resolver with composition, explicit selection, extension fallback, confinement, and fail-closed validation.
Added shared PDF Styler skill derived from Design Workspace v0.24.0, preserving style schema/preset and adapting default style resolution to the local manifest.
Wired capability routing into root context, CLI, workspace metadata, impact policy, docs, and regression tests.
Fixed token-profiler skill grouping and measured PDF Styler separately from skills-root metadata.
Updated v0.8 development documentation for lazy shared capabilities.
